title: The Witcher 3: Visual C++ runtimes (only on a missing-VCRUNTIME abort)
description: Companion to witcher3-4.04-dx11, applied by hand only when witcher3.exe aborts complaining about VCRUNTIME140.dll / MSVCP140.dll. Installs Microsoft's vcrun2019, vcrun2013 and vcrun2012 through the vendored winetricks (needs cabextract), which puts native vcruntime/msvcp overrides into the prefix; the benchmark configuration is Wine's builtins, so this is not part of the main recipe.

steps.note: Only needed when the game aborts with a missing VCRUNTIME/MSVCP dll; Wine's builtin runtimes usually suffice.

steps.text: Native Visual C++ runtimes are now in the prefix (winetricks added their dll overrides to the registry). A benchmark run on this bottle no longer matches the plan's Wine-builtins configuration; note it in the results.

knownIssues.symptom: winetricks fails at once with 'cabextract not found'
knownIssues.cause: The Microsoft redistributables are cab archives; winetricks needs cabextract to unpack them
knownIssues.fix: brew install cabextract, then apply again.
